title: Liquid chrome
description: A sculpted metal loop turns through hard studio highlights and one red reflection.
useCase: Experimental product launches, digital fashion, music identities, or a material-led hero that feels physical.
interaction: Play or pause the material study.
reducedMotion: Displays one stable, representative frame. Responds immediately when the system preference changes.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS composition remains visible when WebGL is unavailable or lost. Raymarching is more GPU-intensive than the other textures. The reflections are authored light bands, not a physical environment map.
look: Near-black poster with a glossy chrome ring of black and silver bands with red reflections, heavy cream sans-serif title, monospace caption and red side label.
motion: A raymarched chrome torus slowly spins and tumbles while its rim and tube thickness undulate, so studio light bands and a red reflection slide across it; a button pauses it.
adapt: The sculpture is the `object` distance function in `FRAGMENT` (spin `.12 * u_time`, `rim` and `tube` wobble); shading uses `studio`, `strip` and `red`, and the 68-step march sets GPU cost. Replace the title and labels; keep `sg-liquid-chrome-fallback`, context-loss and reduced-motion handling.
